5_game_scripts.rule: Favorite is the side laid the points (home spread < 0 means home is favored). underdog_chases: favorite led by 8+ at half and the final favorite margin is 3 or less. favorite_controls: favorite led by 7+ at half and won by 7+. competitive: final favorite margin within 7 and halftime margin within 10, and not already classed. other_unclassified: the rest. Regulation scores. Buckets do not overlap.
